title: Music city hideaway
description:
You’ll be just minutes from restaurants, shops, entertainment, and local attractions. Whether you’re exploring the city, visiting family, or here on business, this spot makes getting around simple and stress-free.

Spotlessly clean and thoughtfully designed for comfort
Fully equipped kitchen for easy meals
Fast Wi-Fi and a smart TV for streaming your favorites
Comfy beds with fresh linens and plenty of pillows
Easy self check-in and free parking

Short term rental permit #2019039067

The space
Our beautiful 2019 house has 3 bedrooms, 3 full bathrooms, and is conveniently located close to downtown, the airport, Nissan Stadium, the Gulch, and more!

One of the three bedrooms is on the main level, while the second and third bedrooms are on the second floor.  The three full bathrooms (one of them on the main level) are perfect for big groups trying to get ready at the same time.

I am always available through Airbnb messaging, phone call, or text!

Guest access
Enjoy having the whole house to yourself! This spacious, spotless home is designed for comfort and convenience — perfect for families, couples, or business travelers.

•You’ll have the entire home all to yourself — no shared spaces
•Free parking right on the property for your convenience
•Large, fully fenced backyard — great for relaxing, grilling, or letting kids play safely
•Comfortable beds with fresh linens
•Fully equipped kitchen and cozy living space
•Fast Wi-Fi and smart TV for entertainment
•Pack ’n Play available for little ones
•Shower chair provided for guests who need extra comfort or accessibility
